_comment: The proofreading test cell (Ames, 2026-10-10). Coordinates are viewer voxels (4 x 4 x 40 nm). scripts/proofreading-test-register.py turns them into supervoxels, checks the cell is in its start state, and prints the SQL for the Supabase editor. A side left out is the anchor (the soma).
title: Proofreading test

checks.label: Cut off the neighbour at the first join
Keep the spine with the synapse
Cut off the neighbour at its other two joins
Continue that branch to its end

_anchor_note: The soma: the densest 6 um region of the cell mesh (17,643 vertices, 90th percentile radius 3.8 um), its centroid inside the segmentation of the cell (supervoxel 75084893952345677), found 2026-10-11 by scripts/find-soma logic; confirm it is the soma in the app.
